feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 9 October 2026 8:23am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 09 October 2026 at 8:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure from the Azores to France. Low pressure near Iceland as a frontal zone continues to gradually clear the British Isles.


##Wind##

Southwest, imminently veering west, 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, but occasionally rough in the east of the area later today & tonight.


##Weather##

Rain at first, then isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in the early rain or showers later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or west-northwest 6 or 7, veering northwest 5 or 6 in the evening, backing west or northwest 4 or 5 overnight into Sunday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough in the east of the area, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
